podcast.title: Debut Performance (1985)
podcast.body: The band made its first public appearance at a community center in December 1985. "They made their debut at a community center in December 1985."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Duration and Breakup
podcast.body: Dane Bramage lasted for almost two years but ultimately ended when Dave Grohl left the band abruptly to join Scream, an opportunity he found irresistible, causing hard feelings among the remaining members. "This band lasted almost two years, but then Dave got a chance to do something else, and he jumped at it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Ultra-Deep Background on Dave Grohl: Part 1

podcast.title: Formation after Mission Impossible
podcast.body: Dave Grohl formed Dane Bramage after Mission Impossible disbanded, marking his next musical venture. "Dave formed a new group called Dane Bramage."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Ultra-Deep Background on Dave Grohl: Part 1

xref.title: Departure from Dane Bramage
xref.body: He abruptly left his band Dane Bramage to join Scream, an offer he "couldn't refuse," which led to hard feelings within Dane Bramage and the band's dissolution. "that band died because Dave bailed. He got an offer that he just couldn't refuse."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Ultra-Deep Background on Dave Grohl: Part 1

xref.title: Early Musical Development
xref.body: Dave Grohl began making music in his teens, progressing through a series of short-lived bands that were crucial to his development before joining Scream, then Nirvana, and eventually forming Foo Fighters. These early groups included Freak Baby, Fast, and Dane Bramage, as well as Mishmash Impossible, which notably opened for DC's Fugazi. "A Mishmash of short live bands that went nowhere but were very important to Dave's development."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Formation at Abingdon School
xref.body: The band that would become Radiohead started forming at Oxford Shears Abingdon School around the same time Dave Grohl was active with Mishmash Impossible and Dane Bramage. "Around the same time Dave was working with Mishm Impossible in Dane Bramage, the band that would become radiohead were getting together at Oxford Shears Abingdon School."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Road Crew Member
xref.body: A person named Dave Smith worked as a member of the Foo Fighters Road Crew for a period. This detail was mentioned in the context of Dave Grohl's departure from his earlier band Dane Bramage, suggesting that not all relationships from his past were negatively affected. "Dave Smith ended up working as a member of the Fouffleiters Road Crew for a time, so not all the bridges were burned."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
